title: ELEPHANT: MEASURING AND UNDERSTANDING SOCIAL SYCOPHANCY IN LLMS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on social sycophancy, defined as the excessive preservation of a user's self-image, in general advice and moral dilemma contexts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as this was not a focus of the research.
